info.name: Sport Challenge API
info.description: Collection de l'API locale, avec ses tests : voir docs/postman.md.

exec: pm.test('200, the build', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.status).to.eql('ok'); pm.expect(b).to.have.keys('status', 'version', 'commit'); });
pm.test('200, the database answers', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.eql({status: 'ok'}); });

pm.test('200, the profile complete', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.first_name).to.eql('Test'); pm.expect(b.last_name).to.eql('Postman'); pm.expect(b.profile_complete).to.eql(true); });
pm.collectionVariables.set('userId', pm.response.json().id);

pm.test('200, my profile', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('userId')); pm.expect(b).to.include.keys('pseudo', 'email', 'language', 'is_admin'); });
pm.test('401 unauthenticated', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(401); const e = pm.response.json().error; pm.expect(e.code).to.eql('unauthenticated'); pm.expect(e.message).to.be.a('string'); });
pm.test('200, the catalogue, cached privately', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Cache-Control')).to.include('private'); });

pm.test('CrossFit and its exercises', () => { const s = pm.response.json().sports.find(x => x.code === 'crossfit'); pm.expect(s, 'crossfit').to.be.an('object'); pm.expect(s.exercises).to.include('burpee'); });
pm.collectionVariables.set('today', new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10));
pm.test('200, profile of B complete', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.collectionVariables.set('otherUserId', pm.response.json().id);

pm.test('201, the challenge created', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(201); const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.reference_sport).to.eql('crossfit'); pm.expect(b.categories.find(c => c.type === 'elimination').params.exercise).to.eql('burpee'); });
pm.collectionVariables.set('challengeId', pm.response.json().id);

pm.test('200, the main challenge with its exercise', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const c = pm.response.json().items.find(x => x.id === pm.collectionVariables.get('challengeId')); pm.expect(c, 'main challenge').to.be.an('object'); pm.expect(c.exercise).to.eql('burpee'); pm.expect(c.my_role).to.eql('creator'); });

pm.test('200, a page with its counts', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.items.length).to.be.at.most(1); pm.expect(b).to.have.property('next_cursor'); pm.expect(b.counts).to.have.keys('upcoming', 'ongoing', 'finished'); });

pm.test('200, the detail', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('challengeId')); pm.expect(b.my_role).to.eql('creator'); pm.expect(b.status).to.eql('ongoing'); pm.expect(b.can_join).to.be.a('boolean'); });
pm.test('403 forbidden', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(403); const e = pm.response.json().error; pm.expect(e.code).to.eql('forbidden'); pm.expect(e.message).to.be.a('string'); });

pm.test('400 validation_failed', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(400); const e = pm.response.json().error; pm.expect(e.code).to.eql('validation_failed'); pm.expect(e.message).to.be.a('string'); });
pm.test('names weeks', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().error.params.fields).to.include('weeks'));
pm.test('201, private', () => pm.response.to.have.status(201));
pm.collectionVariables.set('privateChallengeId', pm.response.json().id);

pm.test('404 challenge_not_found', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(404); const e = pm.response.json().error; pm.expect(e.code).to.eql('challenge_not_found'); pm.expect(e.message).to.be.a('string'); });

pm.test('404 challenge_not_found', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(404); const e = pm.response.json().error; pm.expect(e.code).to.eql('challenge_not_found'); pm.expect(e.message).to.be.a('string'); });
pm.test('200, the title changed', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().title).to.eql('Postman private, renamed'); });
pm.test('204, deleted', () => pm.response.to.have.status(204));

pm.test('404 challenge_not_found', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(404); const e = pm.response.json().error; pm.expect(e.code).to.eql('challenge_not_found'); pm.expect(e.message).to.be.a('string'); });
pm.test('201', () => pm.response.to.have.status(201));
pm.collectionVariables.set('secondChallengeId', pm.response.json().id);
pm.test('201, B active', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(201); pm.expect(pm.response.json().my_status).to.eql('active'); });

pm.test('409 already_participant', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(409); const e = pm.response.json().error; pm.expect(e.code).to.eql('already_participant'); pm.expect(e.message).to.be.a('string'); });

pm.test('200, B active, not creator', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const b = pm.response.json().items.find(x => x.user_id === pm.collectionVariables.get('otherUserId')); pm.expect(b.status).to.eql('active'); pm.expect(b.is_creator).to.eql(false); });
pm.test('200, B creator', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));

pm.test('200, B abandoned, still creator', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.my_status).to.eql('abandoned'); pm.expect(b.my_role).to.eql('creator'); });
pm.test('201', () => pm.response.to.have.status(201));
pm.collectionVariables.set('thirdChallengeId', pm.response.json().id);
pm.test('201, B joined', () => pm.response.to.have.status(201));
pm.test('403 forbidden', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(403); const e = pm.response.json().error; pm.expect(e.code).to.eql('forbidden'); pm.expect(e.message).to.be.a('string'); });
pm.test('204, B excluded', () => pm.response.to.have.status(204));

pm.test('422 participation_abandoned', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(422); const e = pm.response.json().error; pm.expect(e.code).to.eql('participation_abandoned'); pm.expect(e.message).to.be.a('string'); });

pm.test('201, a token and its expiry', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(201); const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.token).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; pm.expect(b.expires_at).to.be.a('string'); });
pm.collectionVariables.set('inviteToken', pm.response.json().token);

pm.test('200, the preview of the main challenge', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.challenge_id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('challengeId')); pm.expect(b.title).to.eql('Postman main'); });

pm.test('201, B active in the main challenge', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(201); const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('challengeId')); pm.expect(b.my_status).to.eql('active'); });

pm.test('409 already_participant', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(409); const e = pm.response.json().error; pm.expect(e.code).to.eql('already_participant'); pm.expect(e.message).to.be.a('string'); });
pm.collectionVariables.unset('inviteToken');
pm.test('403 forbidden', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(403); const e = pm.response.json().error; pm.expect(e.code).to.eql('forbidden'); pm.expect(e.message).to.be.a('string'); });

pm.test('404 invitation_invalid', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(404); const e = pm.response.json().error; pm.expect(e.code).to.eql('invitation_invalid'); pm.expect(e.message).to.be.a('string'); });
const now = Date.now(), dayStart = new Date(new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)).getTime();
const at = minutes => new Date(Math.max(dayStart, now - minutes * 60000)).toISOString(); // in the challenge window: the session only

pm.collectionVariables.set('startedAt', at(6)); pm.collectionVariables.set('runStartedAt', new Date(now - 7 * 60000).toISOString()); pm.collectionVariables.set('otherStartedAt', new Date(now - 30 * 60000).toISOString());
pm.collectionVariables.set('activityKey', pm.variables.replaceIn('{{$guid}}'));
pm.test('201, the burpees recorded', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(201); pm.expect(pm.response.json().repetitions).to.eql([{exercise: 'burpee', repetitions: 30}]); });
pm.test('counts in the main challenge', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().contributions.map(c => c.challenge_id)).to.include(pm.collectionVariables.get('challengeId')));
pm.collectionVariables.set('activityId', pm.response.json().id); pm.collectionVariables.set('activityStartedAt', pm.response.json().started_at);

item.name: POST /activities replayed with the same key

exec: pm.test('200, the activity recorded before, the new body ignored', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('activityId')); pm.expect(b.started_at).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('activityStartedAt')); pm.expect(b.duration_seconds).to.eql(300); pm.expect(b.repetitions).to.eql([{exercise: 'burpee', repetitions: 30}]); });

pm.test('200, replaced', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.duration_seconds).to.eql(240); pm.expect(b.repetitions).to.eql([{exercise: 'burpee', repetitions: 35}]); });

pm.test('404 activity_not_found', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(404); const e = pm.response.json().error; pm.expect(e.code).to.eql('activity_not_found'); pm.expect(e.message).to.be.a('string'); });

pm.test('404 activity_not_found', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(404); const e = pm.response.json().error; pm.expect(e.code).to.eql('activity_not_found'); pm.expect(e.message).to.be.a('string'); });
pm.test('201, the run recorded', () => pm.response.to.have.status(201));
pm.collectionVariables.set('runActivityId', pm.response.json().id);
pm.test('204, deleted', () => pm.response.to.have.status(204));
pm.test('422 unknown_exercise', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(422); const e = pm.response.json().error; pm.expect(e.code).to.eql('unknown_exercise'); pm.expect(e.message).to.be.a('string'); });

pm.test('400 validation_failed', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(400); const e = pm.response.json().error; pm.expect(e.code).to.eql('validation_failed'); pm.expect(e.message).to.be.a('string'); });

pm.test('200, the session with its burpees, not the deleted run', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const items = pm.response.json().items; const a = items.find(x => x.id === pm.collectionVariables.get('activityId')); pm.expect(a.repetitions).to.eql([{exercise: 'burpee', repetitions: 35}]); pm.expect(items.map(x => x.id)).to.not.include(pm.collectionVariables.get('runActivityId')); });

pm.test('200, the totals', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.total).to.be.at.least(1); pm.expect(b.sports.find(x => x.sport_code === 'crossfit').count).to.be.at.least(1); pm.expect(b.challenge_count).to.be.at.least(1); });

pm.test('200, the current week first', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.items.length).to.eql(1); pm.expect(b.items[0].sessions).to.be.at.least(1); pm.expect(b).to.have.property('next_cursor'); });
